title: Baked Bliss
body:
![Block text that says "Baked Bliss"](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/15528aeff58e6b4d49bf1a000f8b11b34cf6619a.png)

_______________________________________________________________________________________________



###  Have you ever wanted more variation to your baked goods consumption? Well have no fear, as this mod adds Berry Jam, White Chocolate Cookies, Pumpkin Bread and more, along with new items to craft them!

**EMI is heavily recommended for this mod!**
_______________________________________________________________________________________________




## FAQ

**Q: Will this mod be ported to Forge?**

**A: No. I will most likely never port to Forge.**

**Q: Can I port this to Forge?**

**A: No.**

**Q: Can I add this to a modpack?**

**A: Yes! Please credit me though.**

**Q: Will you port to X version?**

**A: Maybe, if you wish to port this mod, please contact me and we can figure it out!**

Thank you so much TheFluffycart55 for the plushie code contributions!
